title: v3.1.1 — Local VTOP Scraper Parity, Predictor & UI Fixes (Nov 2026)
description: Overhauled the on-device Local VTOP scraper to match modern VTOP tables: 10-column attendance table parsing, callStudentAttendanceDetailDisplay detail fetching, separate authorizedID vs authorizedIDX extraction, exam schedule semesterSubId, feedback warmup POST, CGPA payload fix, and contact/acknowledgement loading. Replaced the login engine toggle with a segmented Local/Remote switcher, added a global reCAPTCHA/captcha prompt overlay during background sync, fixed VIT statutory pass-floor and pending-assessment logic in the Marks Predictor, stacked Theory/Lab attendance rows, and improved free classroom slot overlap detection.

title: v3.1.0 — Marks Predictor, UniCC Curves & Faculty Reviews (Nov 2026)
description: Integrated UniCC cohort statistics (mean, standard deviation, and student count normalized to 100-point scale) into the Marks Predictor and per-course FAT solver. Added Predicted & Maximisable grade/mark cards, segmented Locked/Pending/Lost progress bar, Predicted Grade Cutoffs (S–E), and editable pending Theory/Lab FAT rows. Rebuilt Faculty Directory from the FFCS report with your course faculties hoisted first, disk-cached vitfac catalog, cached faculty photos, weekly schedule sheet, and the vitfac Reviews popup pane (Lecture/DA/Vibe metrics, course filter, Green/Red flags). Fixed Lab-Only course credits fallback, embedded-course weighted averages, Grade History layout, and attendance sync empty-response protection.

title: v3.0.0 — Material 3 Expressive Overhaul & FFCS Parity (Nov 2026)
description: Complete Material 3 Expressive redesign across Home, Attendance, Academics, Course Detail, Timetable, Profile, Settings, and Campus Features. Added canonical embedded-course semantics (theory/lab credit weighting), overall Attendance & Bunk Predictor, Free Classrooms overhaul, FFCS Planner & export builders, Friend Finder, Student Report PDF/QR/HTML exports, cache-first Bus Routes, Circulars, Grade History, and amazecc:// deep links.

title: Initial release
description: After being in public beta for a while, we are excited to announce the initial release of our app with a wide range of features and improvements.
